(2) from .next via TXA; BNE each: .next is reached by BNE next after ADC #0 (non-zero result means no carry out, C=0) or by BCS hit not taken (C=0); TXA keeps C. No other reference to .each or to span_in_zone+N (grep of src and tools); sky_edges only reads zone_n. With C=0, SBC span_x_hi == CLC; SBC span_x_hi on A, all flags (the following STA/LDA overwrite N/Z, SEC overwrites C, V dead), span_d+1 identical; no stack or interrupt-visible change (interrupts see no different memory; CLC changed no shared state). Saves CLC: 2 cycles an iteration, 1 byte. The one-byte shift of the code after it is a layout/page-crossing question for the gate, not semantics.
